test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement:**

No kettle is a stove.

All stoves are lighters.

**Conclusions:**

I. No kettle is a lighter.

II. No lighter is a kettle.

III. Some lighters are stoves.

IV. All lighters are stoves.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Both conclusions I and IV follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4c536d1a37ea602a9309d6a0f12a74c73b82db42839620390ffd2bb0571b3e4.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No kettle is a lighter → Does not follow (As All stoves are lighters and No kettle is a stove so, No kettle is a lighter is false)

II. No lighter is a kettle → Does not follow (As All stoves are lighters and No kettle is a stove so, No lighter is a kettle is false)

III. Some lighters are stoves →** Follow** (As All stoves are lighters so, Some lighters are stoves is true)

IV. All lighters are stoves → Does not follow (As All stoves are lighters so, All lighters are stoves is false)

∴** Here, 'Only conclusion III is follow'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion III follows".**
